meta.name: doc-coauthoring
meta.description: Guide users through a structured workflow for co-authoring documentation. Use when user wants to write documentation, proposals, technical specs, decision docs, or similar structured content. This workflow helps users efficiently transfer context, refine content through iteration, and verify the doc works for readers. Trigger when user mentions writing docs, creating proposals, drafting specs, or similar documentation tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按结构化流程协作撰写文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要与他人协作撰写结构化的文档或提案
copy.tagline_en: Collaborate on structured documentation with a guided workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to co-author structured documents or proposals with others

howto.what: Claude 会带你有步骤地一起写文档：先问背景、提澄清问题，再逐节头脑风暴、筛选要点、起草和改稿，最后用不带上下文的新 Claude 试读，找出读者看不懂的地方。
howto.when: 当你说要写文档、起草提案，或提到 PRD、设计文档、决策文档等结构化写作任务时触发。

say.text: 我想写一份决策文档，先帮我梳理需要哪些背景信息
say.note: 进入上下文收集，Claude 会提澄清问题

say.text: 我们逐节来，先从最不确定的核心提案部分开始
say.note: 进入逐节头脑风暴、筛选与起草

say.text: 文档写好了，帮我模拟读者会提哪些问题
say.note: 进入读者测试，检查盲点

howto.what_en: Claude walks you through three stages when writing a doc: gather context with clarifying questions, brainstorm and refine each section, then test it with a fresh Claude to catch reader blind spots.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say you want to write a doc, draft a proposal, or create a spec, PRD, design doc, or RFC.

say_en.text: I want to write a decision doc; help me gather the needed context first
Let's go section by section, starting with the core proposal
The doc is done; simulate the questions readers might ask
say_en.note: Runs reader testing for blind spots
